predecessors.name: Tahirid dynasty
predecessors.text: Tabaristan, where Hasan ibn Zayd was 'recognized as emir by a part of the local population' in 864

successors.name: Samanid Empire
successors.text: Tabaristan and Rayy, conquered by the Samanid general Asfar ibn Shiruya in 928

successors.name: Ziyarid dynasty
successors.text: Tabaristan and Gurgan, taken by Mardavij after Asfar's fall (the Alid page lists the Ziyarids among the successors)

ledger.x: 864: Hasan ibn Zayd founds the Zaydi emirate in Tabaristan.
865: Hasan is driven out of Tabaristan.
865: Hasan is back in Tabaristan the same year.
874: the Saffarid army, 'hurt by heavy rain and disease', withdraws shortly after; the page does not say when Hasan came back from Daylam.
889: Rafi' ibn Harthama overruns the Zaydid domains.
c. 896: Gurgan is recovered. 'Rafi' was killed shortly after by his rivals the Saffarids, whereupon Muhammad recovered Gurgan as well' (the Amr page puts Rafi's death in Khwarazm in 896).
3 October 900: Muhammad ibn Zayd dies and the Samanids take Tabaristan.
October 900: the fighting ends with the Samanid victory at Gurgan.
914: the Samanids, whose amir Ahmad was murdered in January 914, leave Tabaristan to al-Utrush ('Taking advantage of the murder of Ahmad ibn Ismai'il soon after').
January 914: Hasan al-Utrush restores the Zaydi emirate.
928: the Samanids end the Zaydi state.
928: the Zaydi emirate of Tabaristan ends under the second Samanid conquest.

wars.name: Zaydi–Tahirid war over Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Hasan chased out in 865 by Sulayman ibn Abdallah, back in Tabaristan by 867 and usually in control of Gurgan from 867.

wars.name: Saffarid invasion of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Ya'qub beat the Zaydid forces at Sari; his army withdrew shortly after, hurt by rain and disease.

wars.name: Zaydi–Abbasid wars of Hasan ibn Zayd
wars.outcome: Rayy changed hands repeatedly (864-865, 867, 870 and 872 under Hasan); Muhammad ibn Zayd failed to take it from Asategin in August 885; Gurgan lost in spring 877.

wars.name: Rafi' ibn Harthama's invasion of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Rafi' occupied most of the Zaydid domains 889-892; Muhammad re-entered Amul on 24 June 893 and recovered Gurgan after Rafi's death.

wars.name: Samanid conquest of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Samanid victory near Gurgan; Muhammad ibn Zayd died on 3 October 900; Alids in exile in Daylam 900-913.

wars.name: Zaydi restoration under al-Utrush
wars.outcome: Crushing defeat of the Samanid army at Burdidah in December 913; Tabaristan and Gurgan recovered in 914.

wars.name: Samanid reconquest of Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Asfar ibn Shiruya took Tabaristan and Ray in 928, ending the state.

certainty.note: Mountain and forest frontiers of Tabaristan, Daylam and Gilan; Rayy, Gurgan and Qazvin changed hands repeatedly and are only ever approximate.
